limitations: Reconstruction uses the runtime default legacy observation layout. Self scalars and sim stats are invariant to clean-obs opt-in and are the only observation fields used. This does not claim full clean observation equality.
Legacy entity bytes can be stale. Nearby enemy liveness is not reported from observation bytes. Terminal flags and agent_stat HP are authoritative for death and HP.
attack_animation means find_target set attack animation before target search. It does not prove a target existed, contact, or damage.

walk_fired and run_fired mean movement animation was set after destination checks, only on alive, nonterminal, play-mode (ui==0) intervals. walk_no_anim and run_no_anim mean no matching movement animation, not inferred coordinates.
net_hp_lost is net HP delta, not raw attack damage; regen and healing can offset losses.
scoring_evidence is false. This output is not scoring evidence and contains no score, winner, rank, or local delta.
